task: OB-01 outlier-segment review (historical replay; not live, not for display)
method: For each target route x stop pair, every matched trip on the review days is traced on raw pings. A slow trip takes at least 3x its scheduled time (minimum 60 s). 'Frozen' stretches are consecutive pings whose SIRI distance advances by at most 10 m; net GPS movement over them separates a standstill ('stationary', frozen for at least 50% of the run) from a frozen-distance artefact (at least 300 m of GPS movement). Heuristic, unreviewed by a human.
